verdict.rationale: The things a user builds with Codex Plugins are stored in open, portable formats. Skills are plain directories containing a SKILL.md built on the open agent skills standard, and plugins use a portable Agent Plugins `plugin.json` schema plus open MCP. A hands-on probe confirmed that third-party tooling can install the catalog's skills outside Codex, so these artifacts are not locked in. However, nothing documents an export of all user data (account, installed-plugin state, plugin-generated data) as a leave-the-platform workflow. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, coverage of non-file data such as installed plugins and settings, and independent corroboration of migrating away.
